$comment: Teaching level 1 (overhaul): a gentle tutorial in four steps. Walk the Shaper to the shore, raise two dwellings, grow to 14 followers (the dormant islet shrine wakes), then Raise Land across the strait and pray.
name: The Narrow Water
description: A shrine sleeps on the islet across the strait. Walk your Shaper to the shore, build two dwellings and grow the tribe to fourteen. Then the shrine wakes: Raise Land toward it and send three followers to pray.

rewards.text: The shrine answers: two Bolts are yours to cast.

objectives.text: Walk your Shaper to the eastern shore of the island
Raise two dwellings so the tribe can breed (D places a plan)
Raise Land across the strait and send three followers to the shrine

do.text: Walk the Shaper to the eastern shore of the island.
Now plan two dwellings near the Hearth. Settlers chop wood and build them.
Dwellings breed new followers. Keep them stocked with wood and wait for the tribe to grow.
The shrine across the strait is waking. Raise Land from the shore, then send three followers.
Strait still open? Raise Land recharges from your mana; cast it from the very edge of the shore.
Three minutes remain. If you are stuck, restart the level from the pause menu.
